title: Agriculture Atlas: Zero-IoT Virtual Agro-Sensor Twins and Offline Zero-Literacy Agronomic Reference Systems for Climate-Vulnerable Smallholder Farming
description: Agriculture Atlas is a 100% non-commercial, open-science reference agronomic atlas aligned with UN SDG #2 (Zero Hunger) and UN SDG #13 (Climate Action). It combines deterministic FAO-56 Penman-Monteith agro-physics, seven Virtual Agro-Sensor Twin reference indices over Uber H3 (Res-7/Res-8) and Overture Maps land-use geometries, an MIT/Apache-2.0 four-SKU foundation model architecture designed for Microsoft Azure NVIDIA GPUs and NVIDIA Brev (Aurora, cBottle-SR, FourCastNet 3, TerraMind-1.0, THOR-1.0, Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4, Qwen3-ASR, VieNeu-TTS-v3, MobileNetV4-Small, Gemma-4-E2B, Qwen3.5-0.8B), sub-5 KB zlib-compressed offline delta packets, and zero-literacy voice-and-pictogram mobile UX for smallholder farmers starting with a five-zone Vietnam pilot.
notes: Software licensed under Apache-2.0; Technical Report (docs/technical-report/AGRICULTURE_ATLAS_TECHNICAL_REPORT_V1.md) and original reference documentation licensed under CC-BY-4.0. Outputs are reference agronomic indices only and not official hydrometeorological forecasts or statutory disaster warnings.
